events_seen: TRADE (Jul 17): Adam receives Justin Herbert (QB, LAC). Fronge receives Jacory Croskey-Merritt (RB, WAS), C.J. Stroud (QB, HOU), 2028 R1 pick.
TRADE (Jul 10): Adam receives Keaton Mitchell (RB, LAC). Wingard receives 2028 R3 pick.
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 21): Drew added Colbie Young (WR, CIN) (dropped Joe Mixon (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Jun 08): Adam added Cyrus Allen (WR, KC) (dropped Phil Mafah (RB, DAL)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 27): Charles added Chris Brooks (RB, GB) for $1 FAAB (dropped Austin Ekeler (RB, FA)).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 16): Charles added Matt Hibner (TE, BAL) (dropped Moliki Matavao (TE, NO)).
CUT (May 16): Charles released Zonovan Knight (RB, ARI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 13): Shaq added Zavion Thomas (WR, CHI).
WAIVER CLAIM (May 12): Adam added John Michael Gyllenborg (TE, KC) (dropped Elijah Higgins (TE, ARI)).
CUT (May 11): Jake released Evan Hull (RB, HOU).

tweets.name: Dina Ravioli
tweets.text: The Deepwater situation has moved. I'm told Mitchum has had preliminary conversations with at least two counterparties in the last week. Nothing close to filed, but the posture has shifted — this is no longer a board quietly grumbling. Someone is actually picking up the phone.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Adam flips Stroud AND Croskey-Merritt AND a 2028 first for Herbert and everyone's debating roster construction. THAT IS A 2028 FIRST. In THIS league. For a quarterback Fronge will be starting in HAVANA. I need a segment. I need it now.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The Herbert acquisition is the kind of move that looks like the answer to a question Helix wasn't supposed to be asking yet. Adam went from 'compelling rebuild story' to 'legitimate threat' in one transaction window, and I don't think the exchange has fully priced what a Herbert-led superflex roster does when the TE room gets patched. That's the next chapter.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: ForgeHammer gave up a 2028 first-rounder and C.J. Stroud and people are asking whether Fronge got good value. The real question is whether Havana has a reliable internet connection for the draft. Geography is the most undervalued roster-construction variable in this league.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: Crownline is still the most valuable listing on the exchange and Charles has a waiver-wire running back situation that I would describe, charitably, as artisanal. $135.34. Championship-or-bust. Chris Brooks off a $1 FAAB claim. These things are not reconciled.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: The trade conversation is all Herbert, Herbert, Herbert. Meanwhile Keaton Mitchell is sitting on the Helix roster right now, quietly filling an RB void that was a real problem six weeks ago. That deal closed July 10th and barely got a news cycle. Nobody cares about the second transaction until the first one doesn't work.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: Sovereign's pick-hoarding strategy is going to look very different when the 2027 class actually hits and every team that traded futures to win now is sitting on a hollow roster. I've been saying this since the preseason. The discount is temporary. The debt is not.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: Drew added Colbie Young off waivers and dropped Joe Mixon in the same move. I want to be generous here. I want to say this is a youth-over-age calculation made with long-term intent. But Atlas is at $44.38 and the most charitable reading of that waiver wire is a franchise rearranging the furniture.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Tonight on the Exchange Report: Dina has more on the Deepwater movement, Vance has a buy/sell on the post-Herbert Helix valuation, and we will attempt to get a straight answer from Terrence about whether ForgeHammer's Havana filing timeline is a competitive advantage or a punchline. Both cases have been made on this network in the last 48 hours.
